Presenting the full video song "Chandni Chowk To China" title track featuring Akshay Kumar & Deepika Padukone. The song is sung by Neeraj Shridhar, Anushka Manchandani, Shankar Mahadeva and the music is composed by Shankar Loy Ehsaan. The lyrics are written by Rajat Arora.
Song - Chandni Chowk To China

Lyricist - Rajat Arora
Music - Shankar Mahadevan, Loy Mendosa, Ehsaan Noorani
Artist - Akshay Kumar & Deepika Padukone
Music On - T Series
